tasks.title: Lecture #70
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a history class.
tasks.transcript:
Petra is an ancient city located in present-day Jordan. It was established as early as 312 BC as the capital city of the Nabataean Kingdom. The Nabataeans were skilled traders, and Petra became a major trading hub because of its strategic location along Karavan routes that linked the East and West.
Petra's architecture is unique because much of it was carved directly into the rose red cliffs of the region. The most famous structure in the city is known as the treasury, but it is actually a tomb.
The city also featured a complex system to manage water, including dams, cisterns, and water channels that allowed it to thrive in the arid region. These advanced water engineering structures were crucial for the survival of its inhabitants, given the low amount of moisture that was available naturally.
In addition to its architectural and engineering feats, Petra is significant for its cultural exchanges. As a trading center, it facilitated the exchange of goods, ideas, and customs between diverse peoples. This blend of cultures is evident in the various architectural styles seen in the city, which include influences from Greek, Roman, and indigenous Nabataean designs.
Next, we will explore how archaeologists rediscovered Petra in the 19th century.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The rediscovery of Petra's rock - cut architecture
options.B: The significance of the ancient city of Petra
options.C: Caravan routes used by Nabataean traders
options.D: The daily life of the Nabataean people

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这段谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Petra is an ancient city... established... became a major trading hub... architecture is unique... significant for its cultural exchanges. 选项分析： A. The rediscovery of Petra's rock-cut architecture 佩特拉岩石建筑的重新发现。谈话末尾提到 next 会讲 rediscovered，但这不是本段的主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. The significance of the ancient city of Petra 佩特拉古城的重要性。谈话分别讲述了佩特拉作为贸易中心、独特建筑、水利工程、文化交流地等多方面的重要性，所以B选项正确。 C. Caravan routes used by Nabataean traders 纳巴泰商人使用的商队路线。谈话中只提到一句佩特拉位于商队路线沿线，但不是主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. The daily life of the Nabataean people 纳巴泰人的日常生活。谈话中未具体描述日常生活，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply about the structure known as the Treasury?

options.A: It was similar to buildings in other kingdoms.
options.B: Its name does not reflect its purpose.
options.C: It is a lesser - known building.
options.D: It was part of Petra's water - management system.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者关于被称为“宝库”的建筑暗示了什么？ 定位原文：The most famous structure in the city is known as the treasury, but it is actually a tomb. 选项分析： A. It was similar to buildings in other kingdoms. 它与其他王国的建筑相似。谈话中未提及，所以A选项错误。 B. Its name does not reflect its purpose. 它的名称不能反映它的用途。说话者说它被称为 treasury，但实际上是一座坟墓（tomb），暗示名称与实际用途不符，所以B选项正确。 C. It is a lesser-known building. 它是一座不太知名的建筑。说话者说它是城里最著名的建筑（most famous），所以C选项错误。 D. It was part of Petra's water-management system. 它是佩特拉水利系统的一部分。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker point out about the city's water system?

options.A: It allowed Petra to survive in a dry location.
options.B: It consisted mostly of channels carved into cliffs.
options.C: It depended on water channels flowing east to west.
options.D: It was built by Greek and Roman engineers.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者指出了关于城市水利系统的什么？ 定位原文：These advanced water engineering structures were crucial for the survival of its inhabitants, given the low amount of moisture that was available naturally. 选项分析： A. It allowed Petra to survive in a dry location. 它使佩特拉得以在干旱地区生存。说话者明确说水利系统对居民生存至关重要，因为自然降水少，所以A选项正确。 B. It consisted mostly of channels carved into cliffs. 它主要由开凿在悬崖上的水渠组成。谈话中提到 dams, cisterns, water channels，但未说“mostly” channels，也未说全部 carved into cliffs，所以B选项不够准确。 C. It depended on water channels flowing east to west. 它依赖于自东向西流动的水渠。谈话中未提及流向，所以C选项错误。 D. It was built by Greek and Roman engineers. 它是由希腊和罗马工程师建造的。谈话中提到建筑风格受希腊、罗马影响，但未说水利系统是他们建造的，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about Petra's culture?

options.A: It was the main factor in Petra's economic success.
options.B: It was a mixture of several cultures.
options.C: It is still a mystery for archaeologists.
options.D: It continues to influence Petra's inhabitants today.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者关于佩特拉的文化说了什么？ 定位原文：This blend of cultures is evident in the various architectural styles seen in the city, which include influences from Greek, Roman, and indigenous Nabataean designs. 选项分析： A. It was the main factor in Petra's economic success. 它是佩特拉经济成功的主要因素。谈话中未比较不同因素的重要性，所以A选项错误。 B. It was a mixture of several cultures. 它是多种文化的融合。说话者明确说“blend of cultures”，所以B选项正确。 C. It is still a mystery for archaeologists. 对考古学家来说仍然是个谜。谈话中未提及，所以C选项错误。 D. It continues to influence Petra's inhabitants today. 它至今仍在影响佩特拉的居民。谈话中未提及当今居民，且佩特拉现在已是古城遗址，所以D选项错误。
